entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A female merfolk from Bala Ged on Zendikar who helped Jace and Gideon against the Eldrazi.

entities.description: The plane overrun by the Eldrazi.

entities.description: Region of Zendikar overrun by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Kendrin
entities.description: Human friend of Jori En who studied the puzzle of leylines and died.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: Where Jori En and Kendrin fled.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: City with a Lighthouse holding records on the Eye of Ugin; destroyed.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker who recruited Jace and rescued Jori En.

entities.name: Jace Beleren

entities.description: Eldrazi titan that attacked Sea Gate.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: Wounded planeswalker helped by Jori En.

entities.name: Zendikar's Last Stand
entities.description: Last confrontation with Ulamog and Kozilek in which the titans were defeated by the Gatewatch and allies.

entities.name: Gatewatch

events.summary: After the Eldrazi overran Bala Ged, Jori En fled with Kendrin to Tazeem; Kendrin died before reaching Sea Gate.
events.quote: she died before she could accomplish that

events.summary: Gideon went to recruit Jace and told Jori En to join Commander Vorik's refugees.
events.quote: He told Jori En to join Commander Vorik's refugees so that he could find her when he returned.

events.summary: Gideon rescued Jori En from Sea Gate and brought her to Jace.
events.quote: He rescued her again and brought her to Jace

events.summary: Jace and Jori En were ambushed by the Eternal Pilgrims and barely escaped Ulamog.
events.quote: the two were ambushed by the Eternal Pilgrims

events.summary: Jace and Jori En split up; Jori En went back to warn Gideon.
events.quote: They then decided to split up

events.summary: After Sea Gate's destruction Jori En found and helped the wounded Kiora retrieve her bident.
Jori En survived Zendikar's Last Stand.
events.quote: the titans were defeated by the Gatewatch and their allies
